items.question: How many days does the Dubai Electricity and Water Authority's Al Namoos service take to provide an electricity connection for projects up to 150 kW?
items.fact: DEWA Al Namoos connects projects up to 150kW within 5 days

items.question: What documents must the applicant submit to Al Ain Distribution Company for a new tenant electricity and water registration?
items.gold: Attested tenancy contract, new clearance certificate for the meter, tenant's valid Emirates ID, and trade/industrial licence (for commercial/industrial).
items.fact: Al Ain Distribution Company requires four listed documents for new tenant registration
